reviews.text: We turned to Rodrigo when we adopted a nearly one-year-old puppy and needed some advice for daily life. Nox is calmer on walks and interacts better with our cat. We highly recommend him!!

We had 8 sessions with Rodrigo and we were satisfied with the follow-up. We started with the most basic exercises and progressed as Tsuki improved.
Rodrigo was always available to clarify our doubts and gave us good tips, mainly to correct some mistakes we were making during walks and in the use of the leash.
Throughout the sessions we felt progress in Tsuki's behavior and, in the end, we were left with the tools and knowledge necessary to continue working and improving at home.

We had several classes with Rodrigo focused mainly on getting our dog Ralf to walk with a leash without pulling and not to react like a possesed demon when encountering other dogs. We saw improvements early on and after about 8 classes the progress was amazing. Can highly recommend Rodrigo for dog training. He’s amazing with dogs, methodical, communicative, kind and just and overall cool guy! Classes were structured and well thought out, beginning at home and progressing to different environments outside.
Really enjoy working with Rodrigo. My dogs are quite reactive so it’s not an easy task, but Rodrigo provides clear rules and instructions.

Rodrigo was a great trainer, not only for Paçoca, but also for me and my family. We were able to use his teachings to create a safe and comfortable environment for the dog. We could see his professionalism right after the first session, where he proved to be reliable and straightforward.

Furthermore, he was very observant of our mistakes and has extraordinary patience with our puppy and my family, who have no experience whatsoever in caring for dogs, much less a Jack Russell Terrier.

We quickly learned the basic, but important, rules that would help in Paçoca's training. Especially leash control, which, with Rodrigo's help and support, turned a challenging cycle into something much more essential and beneficial for our dog.

Paçoca not only loved Rodrigo's presence, but we also noticed that, amidst all the training and restrictions, he maintained a great affection for him. Rodrigo performed the role perfectly, and helped Paçoca feel safer going outside and more in control around visitors and new people in his life.

It was a great choice, and the tips and training we received are making living with our dog much easier. He started out aggressive and unpredictable, but now, knowing how to read body language and behavior more easily, he's on a more controlled and happy path for both of us and for Paçoca.

Non-Portuguese-speaking clients look elsewhere

I booked the Behavioral Consulting and Essential Program expecting professional, personalized training that would teach me how to handle my dog with more confidence. Unfortunately, what followed was an immensely frustrating training experience and an even more disappointing customer experience when I decided not to continue the training.

After three sessions, it became very clear that I wasn’t learning how to handle my dog independently. When I struggled, Rodrigo would often simply take the leash and perform the exercise himself instead of explaining what I was doing wrong and how to correct it. Unsurprisingly, watching the trainer succeed did little to make me a more confident handler.

The language barrier made this considerably worse. Basic instructions were understandable but the reasoning behind them wasn’t. Rather than adapting his teaching or taking the time to explain things in a way I could understand, Rodrigo repeatedly resorted to demonstration. When I eventually raised the language barrier directly, he dismissed my concern because, according to him, the training was producing results. If you're looking for clear explanations in English, I strongly recommend finding another trainer.

If you do decide to work with Rodrigo, think very carefully before paying for a larger package upfront. After the initial consultation, I committed to an 8-session program for €400 before I could realistically know how many sessions I needed or whether his teaching style would work for me and my dog. When I decided to stop after three sessions, I asked for a refund of the five unused sessions but Rodrigo refused.

I tried to reach an amicable solution, but there was essentially no customer-oriented response beyond lengthy explanations of why he believed he was entitled to retain the full payment. No cancellation or refund policy was communicated to me when I booked. Had I known that ending the program early would mean forfeiting the entire remaining value, I would never have booked the package.

Rodrigo may respond that the training produced results or that discontinuing was my choice. Neither addresses my concerns. A trainer successfully handling your dog is not the same as successfully teaching you how to handle your dog.

Based on both the training and the way my concerns were handled afterwards, I cannot recommend Rodrigo. If you do not speak Portuguese, look elsewhere.

Rodrigo trained me to be a dog trainer. More than teaching the technical aspects, Rodrigo was an incredible teacher, always very patient and encouraging. When I hesitated, he made me believe in myself and my potential, always reminding me that training should be, above all, a fun experience. His teaching method won me over with its simplicity. Here, complicated tricks or acrobatics aren't taught. The focus is on what matters: creating a healthy, simple, and harmonious relationship between the dog and its family every day. It's such a practical training method that it's easy to teach and apply to anyone. Another great advantage is that the training isn't just for the animal; Rodrigo also trains the owners, because they are the ones who will be dealing with the dog daily after the training sessions end and need to know how to act. I recommend his work to anyone looking for real and simple results for a happy and healthy life with their companion! 🐶 Furthermore, I believe that investing in this training was a good investment!

I adopted a puppy and sought out Rodrigo to help with the training.
I opted for the 8-lesson package and I believe it served its purpose very well as an introduction to the canine world.

The first session is quite valuable, where he teaches some basic concepts of canine behavior and also shows some toy options that are worth having at home.

During the other sessions, we learned how to handle the leash and also how to communicate properly with the dog. As it is our first dog, during the first lessons we felt a little more resistance from Rodrigo because we had difficulty doing exactly what he asked. As the sessions went on, we became familiar with his teaching style, with the leash and with our dog, and the lesson flowed smoothly.

We are applying the teachings from the lessons in our daily walks and we already feel a difference.

Something we learned is that training happens on both ends of the leash and that patience and dedication from both sides are needed to see results :)

We just completed a "12 pack" training session with Rodrigo and our now ~8 month old puppy.  Our final take-away message from the classes was that she was a better student than we were. lol

But...seriously... Rodrigo's techniques are very, very good. Even when we were struggling to replicate what he was teaching us, it was clear his techniques were NOT the problem because our puppy always responded perfectly when Rodrigo was doing the exercises. We soon learned that the classes were almost more for *us* than the dog. After all, you can't really expect a dog to be a good student if you aren't a good teacher yourself.

Other things - Rodrigo is 100% reliable. He arrives on time always and is very respectful of his client's time. He is a patient and calm teacher, even when we were getting frustrated at our own struggles (which did happen a bit). One thing I would suggest to maybe make it easier - for him (or one of the clients if there are 2 of you) to video you doing various techniques during class so that you can really SEE what you are doing "wrong."  We found it a little challenging to do an exercise and then maybe make 5-6 small mistakes, but it would be difficult to understand all the mistakes without visually SEEING them. Sometimes we thought we were doing something right, but we actually weren't because we were focussed on something else. Video would help.  We alternated classes (my wife and I) after a bit so I could watch her make mistakes, and she could watch me.  We actually learned a bit better that way I think, so a few short 15-20 second videos each class would be really helpful in my opinion.

Overall, very good classes. And, if it matters to you, Rodrigo's English is excellent so there is no concern if you are an expat and can't do classes in Portuguese.

We may do more classes in the future, but for now we really need to work on what we have learned so we can perfect those things. One thing I would suggest is to start classes as soon as possible. We waited a few months too long so we developed more bad habits that we have had to break. :-)
